# Mateo Cerri

> Tinkerer working from Rafaela, Argentina. Takes things apart to see what
> else they could become: agent tooling, computer vision, low-level
> experiments. Prefers showing commits over collecting labels.

Advanced Computer Engineering student at UNRaf (B.S. in progress, final
project on visual inspection). Independent developer since 2026:
designed, deployed, and maintains a custom e-commerce platform for
Beccaria Mayorista (Astro, React, AdonisJS, PostgreSQL).

## Availability

Open to selected freelance and consulting work. Remote, async-friendly.
Contact: hi@mateocerri.com (details at https://mateocerri.com/contact).

## Pages

- [Home](https://mateocerri.com/): profile, current work, selected projects, record
- [Blog](https://mateocerri.com/blog): notes on building, with recaps and takeaways
- [Contact](https://mateocerri.com/contact): email, socials, Spanish-language note
- [Giving my agent tools that show their work](https://mateocerri.com/blog/giving-agent-auditable-tools): two OpenCode plugins (script registry, anchor-based edits) and the 70-file rename that proved them
- [The bug was a missing .exe](https://mateocerri.com/blog/upstream-shot-that-missed): contributing upstream to kache (Rust build cache) instead of building a private tool
- [The binary follows the data](https://mateocerri.com/blog/binary-follows-the-data): a shim that picks the right executable per platform at the Windows/Linux boundary

## Selected work

- opencode-patchflow / opencode-scriptbox (+ slim-output, wsl-shim): visible tools for coding agents — https://github.com/mateocerri
- hlsd: HLS recording daemon, every segment fetched exactly once — https://github.com/mateocerri/hlsd
- Beccaria Mayorista: wholesale e-commerce platform, live — https://beccariamayorista.com.ar/
- Upstream Rust contributions: kache (build cache), Graphite (2D editor)
